column1: # The checks of shell/password.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh.
# Questions on AMITSESetup show no value, and nothing shows its bytes

column3: .responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("<ValueUnavailable: VarStore holds a password>"))
any(.[]; .name == "Quiet Boot" and (.answer | startswith("<ValueUnavailable: VarStore holds a password>")))

column1: # set refuses to write in a HiiDB that declares a password question

column3: . == {"error_message": "this HiiDB declares a setup password question; the UEFI Shell runs no setup browser, so no password is asked or checked; pass --bypass-setup-password to write anyway"}
. == {"error_message": "this HiiDB declares a setup password question; the UEFI Shell runs no setup browser, so no password is asked or checked; pass --bypass-setup-password to write anyway"}

column1: # which never lets it write AMITSESetup

column3: . == {"error_message": "EFI variable AMITSESetup-8c78a505-baa0-4c4a-869f-000000000101 holds a password, which the UEFI Shell build never reads or writes"}
. == {"error_message": "EFI variable AMITSESetup-8c78a505-baa0-4c4a-869f-000000000101 holds a password, which the UEFI Shell build never reads or writes"}

column1: # nor a volatile variable: ConOutDev starts with 02 on x86_64 and i686, 01 on aarch64

column3: . == {"error_message": "EFI variable ConOutDev-8be4df61-93ca-11d2-aa0d-00e098032b8c is volatile (no EFI_VARIABLE_NON_VOLATILE), so a write would not outlast a power cycle; pass --allow-volatile to write it anyway"}

column1: # unless --allow-volatile is given: 3 keeps the device path valid, and lasts until the next reset

column3: .responses | length == 1 and .[0].question.answer == "3 <volatile: lasts until the next reset or power cycle>" and .[0].modified == true

column1: # variable-info shows the attributes and the size of AMITSESetup, never its data

column3: . == {"error_message": "vendor 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F is not a GUID: GUID string has wrong length (expected 36 bytes)"}
